content.newText:
import hashlib

with open("contract.yaml", "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
with open("contract.sha256", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"{digest}  contract.yaml\n")

print(digest)
